canonical_answers: The average rate is −2. | The negative rate means f falls by 2 output units per input unit on average. | The model is f(x)=(x−2)². | Substitution gives outputs 4,1,0,1 at x=0,1,2,3. | The vertex is (2,0), the minimum of the model. | The axis x=2 explains equal values at inputs equally spaced from 2.
